target: Share of an occupation's eligible HN job ads in a country naming the skill, pooled over the 3 months ending at the target month

rules.direction_baseline: last 3 months' pooled share at the origin

methods.shrink: 3-month share shrunk to 12-month share by evidence
methods.ridge: pooled ridge regression on lagged shares, volume and cross-cell skill change
methods.ewma: exponentially weighted recent share, partially pooled across countries
methods.dtrend: shrunk, damped logit-share trend from a weighted line over recent months
methods.adaptive: recent level plus a trend scaled by its measured persistence per evidence band

discovery_backcheck.reference: 12-month share of US software-engineer ads first >= 2%

adjusted_forecast.rule: hybrid lowest validation selection score, beats baseline and control in >= 80% of series resamples, and no worse on test (MAE and selection score)
